about.title: About us
paragraphs: JFS Trading is committed to empowering Ethiopia’s small-scale poultry farmers with high-quality, customized feed. Based in Addis Ababa, we import and deliver Primix, our flagship product, and partner with trusted facilities to create blends for each farm.
Our mission is to make premium, affordable feed accessible, with strict quality assurance and service built around the customer.

heritage.title: Exporting Ethiopia’s coffee heritage
heritage.text: At JFS Trading, we specialize in exporting premium Ethiopian coffee, sourced directly from local farmers. Our coffee is carefully selected to showcase Ethiopia’s rich coffee heritage. We keep the export process seamless, delivering high-quality coffee to international markets while supporting local farmers and sustainable practices.
